HYBRID ARTWORK ONLY. Create exactly two isolated natural human hands, arranged
side by side on a completely plain white opaque background. Modern clean
textbook illustration, natural skin, no costume, no engraving or scan texture.
This will be a small semantic layer beneath separately drawn exact apparatus.

The attached original PNG supplies the two hand poses only. Its tubes,
vessels, fluids and droplets are NOT part of this generation. The complete
modern lesson and seven prompts below are authoritative; do not render their
text or their other figures. No answer key or solution has been supplied.

Both hands are right hands entering from the RIGHT of their own imaginary
vertical pipette, fingers gently pinching an invisible slender upright tube.
In the LEFT hand pose, the index finger curls over and its fleshy fingertip
lies horizontally across the imaginary upper tube opening. The thumb and
another finger grasp the imaginary neck just below it.
In the RIGHT hand pose, the hand still grips the imaginary neck but the index
finger is lifted clearly ABOVE the imaginary upper opening, leaving a visible
air gap. Show the entire hand and a short wrist without cropping fingers.
Leave a clean blank vertical slot under each imaginary opening. The left
index-finger pad should visibly cover the slot's top; the right pad is lifted.
The exact slot/opening geometry will be supplied by a deterministic overlay.

Keep the two hands completely separated, with generous white outer margins.
The LEFT pose occupies the left half of a landscape image, the RIGHT pose the
right half. Use the same scale and skin tone for both hands. Their wrists
should point toward the right edge of their own half, not cross to the other
pose. Hands only: DO NOT draw any tube, pipette, dropper, glass, liquid, beaker,
bulb, droplet, instrument, molecule, planet, symbol, letter, number, label,
arrow, scale, explanatory text, border, panel, shadowed background, grid or
checkerboard. Do not add a third hand or a detached finger.
